title: Origin story: Athena
description: Athena sprang fully grown and armored from the forehead of Zeus after he swallowed her mother, the Titaness Metis. She became the patron of Athens after defeating Poseidon in a contest for the city, offering the olive tree against his salt spring. She favored heroes such as Odysseus, Perseus, and Hercules.

description: Powers: The aegis, a shield bearing the Gorgon's head that routs armies; Owl-sight: perception of hidden truths; Bestowal of victory on the side she favors.

title: Stamina feats: Athena
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Stood unshaken through the gods' fiercest quarrels; Wove through the entire Trojan War as its presiding strategist.

title: Crossover notes: Athena

title: Cultural impact: Athena
description: Emblem of reasoned strength; her owl and olive branch are enduring symbols of wisdom and peace.
